'''Soltan Wostikian''' was the son of [[Joran Wostikian]] and adopted son of [[Jettero Heler]].

==Biography==
Before [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Joran Wostikian and his [[Joran Wostikian's wife|wife]] gave birth to Soltan. Joran and his wife perished in a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] accident, and Soltan was adopted and raised by Jettero Heler. Heler sent Soltan to the [[University of Alderaan/Legends|University of Alderaan]].He/him<ref name="Prelude to ANH" />
